patch.value: Provide descriptor-relative SDK lock acquisition before claiming state confinement

Blocking Cubic thread PRRT_kwDOTqJmqs6yXRp3 reproduces a real check/use race in acquireStateLock. Replacing the locks directory with a symlink after statePath and before the native SDK mkdir writes the lock outside state. acquireStateLease and commitStateTransaction have the same SDK pathname boundary. The pinned SDK 2026.10.27 and inspected 2026.11.1 API expose no descriptor-relative lock/filesystem primitive. A second pathname check does not close the window; a private lease does not exclude ordinary writers. This is an unresolved P1 dependency, not an accepted deferral or completed fix.

Acquire, fence, release, stale cleanup owner writes and recovery audit writes operate through no-follow component handles, or refuse with a typed unsupported/boundary code before following an unsafe path.; Real filesystem regressions swap root, locks, cleanup gate and recovery directory at use; outside bytes and directory entries remain unchanged; ordinary roots and symlinked ancestors above the root retain released behavior.; Preserve native SDK token, stale-owner and fenced-lease semantics without a second hand-written lock protocol or process-global filesystem monkeypatch; regressions fail on revert.
